confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Koh Samui tourist prices for July 2026; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by beach area, property standard and season. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at 2x the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis from general knowledge of Thai island and beach-resort towns such as Phuket, Krabi and Koh Phangan, adjusted for Koh Samui's resort-heavy accommodation mix; no comparable-city price data was looked up.
